data.name: Conduit
data.subtitle: Native client for Open WebUI & Ollama
data.localizedDescription: Conduit is a native, open-source iOS and Android client for Open WebUI, direct OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Ollama and Hermes. Chat with your own self-hosted local models or API-backed ones with a polished SwiftUI interface — conversations stay in sync, code blocks render properly, and your data never touches a third-party server.
data.versionDescription:
Conduit 4.1.8 | conduit

## What's Changed
* Extract shared packages from the mobile app by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/753
* Fix issues found in a simulator verification pass by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/756
* Refine chat, composer, sidebar, and settings UI by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/761
* Fix Android entry points, shares, folders, STT, and keyboard insets by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/766
* Fix streaming lag, tool-call walls, speaker routing, SVG-sniffed PNGs, and lingering Hermes approvals by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/767
* Fix remaining Open WebUI streaming events and task checklists by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/771
* Make icons and settings surfaces follow the theme palette, and fix sign-in from the settings sheet by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/772
* Build iOS and Android targets for ARM only by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/773


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/compare/v4.1.7...v4.1.8

compatibility.notes: Official IPA (conduit.ipa) from the developer's GitHub releases; the debug-flavored bundle (app.cogwheel.conduit.debug) is excluded. Requires a self-hosted Open WebUI/Ollama server or your own API endpoints.
